# Google Gemini image wire fixtures

Retrieved on 2026-08-05 from first-party Gemini API documentation:

- Image generation: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation
- Interactions API: https://ai.google.dev/api/interactions-api-v1

Fixtures use the current `/v1beta/interactions` contract with typed `text` and `image` input parts and `model_output` image content. Prompts and image bytes are synthetic. API keys, project identifiers, and real user media are excluded.
